## History

The Twin Sailor was one of several whimsical, imaginary companions created by [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) near the shore. According to a letter written by [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), the Twin Sailor featured in his fantastic adventures, which included traveling into the sunset and sailing into the moon alongside figures like [Nora](../character/nora.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)_
